title: The Parish Register

authorInfo.bio: George Crabbe (1754–1832) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Parish Register" by George Crabbe is a poetic work that was first published in the early 19th century. The narrative serves as a detailed exploration of village life in England, focusing particularly on the struggles and experiences of the rural poor.
